newsitem.title: EU: EC REPORT WEEKLY DIARY (PAGE 2/3 - TUESDAY-THURSDAY).
newsitem.headline: EC REPORT WEEKLY DIARY (PAGE 2/3 - TUESDAY-THURSDAY).

text.p: TUESDAY (Continued)

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Aviation Club holds lunchtime meeting at 1230/1130 GMT. Speaker is Boeing Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Phil Condit. Venue: Amigo Hotel. Contact: PRP (322) 762 0485.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Van Miert meets Boeing Chairman and Executive Officer Phil Condit at 1530/1430 GMT.
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 12
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Transport Council continues (second of two days).
STRASBOURG (NEW ITEM) - European Commission holds regular weekly meeting (1500/1400 GMT).
Provisional agenda includes:
- Commissioner Monti communication on proposal for directive on taxation of energy products.
- Commissioners Monti and Bangemann communication on the proposal on media ownership in the internal market.
- Reports on results of Altener I programme and on multiannual Alterner II programme promoting renewable energy (PAP).
- Commissioner Flynn communication on modernisation and improvement of social protection in the EU.

- Commissioner Bjerregaard communication on Community strategy against acidification - proposal on sulphur content in certain combustibles - conclusion of EU proposal on the convention protocol on cross-border atmospheric pollution reducing sulphur emissions.
- Commissioner Brittan communication on negotiations in the framework of the OECD for a multilateral accord in investments.
- Commissioner Brittan communication on South Africa's partial membership to the Lome convention.
- Commissioners Wulf-Mathies, Flynn, Fischler, Bonino and Commission President Santer communication on structural fund programmes for Abruzzes region (Italy).
STRASBOURG (EXPANDED ITEM) - European Parliament holds plenary session (third of five days).
Agenda includes:
- (0900/0800 GMT) Votes on objections concerning the debate on topical end urgent subjects of major importance.
- (0915/0815 GMT) Edward Kellett-Bowman on alleged contraventions or maladminstration in the Community Transit System.
- Recommendations by the committee of inquiry into transit fraud.
- Oral questions to the Commission regarding the development of the IGC conference.
- Sakellariou Jannis report on the joint report by the Presidency of the Council and the Commission on Mediterranean policy.
- Council and Commission declaration on the situation in Albania.
- (1200/1100 GMT) Votes: reports without debate
- Pronk Bartho on the European Advisory Committee on statistical information in the economic and social spheres.
- Michael Tappin report on the annual adjustment procedure for daily subsistence allowance rates for officials on mission.
- Soulier Andre on the communication from the Commission on nuclear industries in the EU.
- Miguel Arias Canete on specific measures in favour of cephalopod producers in the Canary Islands.
- (2100/2000 GMT) Joint debate on budget guidelines for 1998.
- Stanislaw Tillich and John Tomlinson on the Commission's report to the Council and the EP: the demographic situation in the EU (1995).
- recommendation for second reading by Mr Liese on North-South cooperation in the campaign against drugs and drug addition
- Recommendation for second reading by Mr Nordmann on aid for population policies and programmes in the developing countries.
- Recommendation for a second reading by Mr Linkohr on the 4th programme of R&TD 1994-1998: supplementary financing of ECU 700m.
- (1730/1630 GMT) Question Time (Council).
- (1900/1800 GMT) Political group meetings.
BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - Committee of the Regions holds plenary session (1700/1600 GMT) (and Thursday).
Provisional agenda includes:
- European Commission green paper on education, training, research: the obstacles to transnational mobility.
- Regional nature parks: examples of sustainable development of the most sensitive areas of the EU.
- New economic activities and new services in rural areas.
- Intercultural education.
- Sixth and seventh annual reports on the structural funds 1994-1995.

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Committee of the Regions holds FORUM on "Better living in our region and cities" (0900/0800 GMT) (and Thursday). Venue: EP, Leopold building. Contact: Committee of the Regions (322) 282 2211.

LYON, France - French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis, German Finance Minister Theo Waigel, French Central Bank Governor Jean-Claude Trichet and German Central Bank Governor Hans Tietmeyer meet to discuss economic issues.
THURSDAY, MARCH 13
BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - Internal Market Council (1000/0900 GMT).
Agenda includes:
- Commission report on legislative simplification.

- White paper on approximation of the laws of the Central and Eastern European Countries in the field of the internal market - Preparation for the meeting with the Central and Eastern European Countries.
- Commission communication on the impact and effectiveness of the internal market - open debate.
- Commission oral presentation on the green paper on public markets (reflection paths for the future).
- Commission presentation on the green paper on "Copyright and neighbouring rights in the information society".
- Common position on the maximum design speed of wheeled agricultural or forestry tractors.

- Proposal for an EP and Council directive amending directive 89/398/EEC on the approximation of the laws of the Member States on foodstuffs intended for particular nutritional uses ("dietary foodstuffs").
- Common position on the directive for the harmonisation of industrial design law.
STRASBOURG - European Parliament holds plenary session (fourth of five days).
Provisional agenda includes:
- (0930/0830 GMT) Political group meetings.
- Recommendation by Magdalene Hoff on the EU/Georgia partnership and cooperation agreement.
- Peter Kittelmann report on the partnership and cooperation agreement with Georgia.
- Peter Kittelmann report on the interim agreement on trade and trade-related matters between EC, ECSC and EAEC and Georgia.
- Recommendation by Panayotis Lambrias on the EU/Azerbaijan partnership and cooperation agreement.
- Konrad Schwaiger report on the partnership and cooperation agreement between the EC and Azerbaijan.
- Catherine Lalumiere report on the EC/Kazakhstan partnership and cooperation agreement.
- Raymond Chesa report on the partnership and cooperation agreement with Kazakhstan.
- (1200/1100 GMT) Votes on: reports under the cooperation, codecision and procedures, motions for resolutions on which the debate is closed.
- (1500/1400 GMT) Topical and urgent subjects of major importance.
- (1800/1700 GMT) Lone Dybkjaer report on guidelines for EU preparations for the U.N. General Assembly special session (New York/June 1997 "Environment and development").
- Antonios Trakatellis report on the contained use of genetically modified micro-organisms.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commission President Santer and Commissioner Wulf-Mathies meet Azores President Carlos Manuel Martins Do Vale Cesar.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Committee of the Regions holds plenary session (0900/0800 GMT) (second of two days).
Provisional agenda includes:
- European Commission report on young farmers and the problem of succession in European agriculture.
- European Commission green paper on the protection of minors and human dignity in audio-visual and information services.
- European Commission communication on illegal and harmful content on the Internet.
- European Commission green paper on future noise policy.
- (1430/1330 GMT) Damage caused by cormorants in the European regions.
- Resolution on the charter of the European regions for the environment.

THE HAGUE (NEW ITEM) - German Chancellor Helmut Kohl and Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel meet Dutch counterparts Prime Minister Wim Kok and Foreign Minister Hans Van Mierlo. Discussions focus on state of the inter-governmental conference, EU and NATO enlargement, planned single currency and key foreign policy issues such as situation in Albania - followed by a news conference at 1800/1700 GMT.

METZ, France - Lorraine Regional Council, under the patronage of the European Commission, holds second European colloquium on "SMEs" (0830/0730 GMT). Topics include: third multiannual programme for SMEs; the euro: regulations and stakes for the single currency. Venue: Espace Saarlorlux. Contact: French EU Representation (322) 229 8461.

AMSTERDAM - Second official ECR Europe - Efficient consumer conference (1000/0900 GMT) (and Friday). Topics include: joining forces - new mindsets for new relationships; the new reality of the supply chain; anticipating and responding to new consumer demand. Venue: Amsterdam RAI, International exhibition and congress centre. Contact: CIES (33) 1 44 34 69 06.
